polls.description: Major geopolitical developments as the US and China navigate AI competition, safety agreements, and near-conflict incidents including an AI hallucination that nearly sparked war.
polls.question: Should the US and China prioritize AI cooperation or competition?

cluster_stories.title: The U.S. and China are quietly talking AI guardrails—even as Trump publicly rejects them
cluster_stories.summary: The U.S. and China just held their first AI dialogue, as Beijing courts the rest of the world with open-source AI.
cluster_stories.headline: US-China SECRETLY Discuss AI Guardrails as Trump Rejects Them

cluster_stories.title: AI Emerges as a Flashpoint in Trump-Xi Talks
cluster_stories.summary: The US-China AI race is emerging as a key issue surrounding talks between President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, as Chinese open-weight models close the gap with leading US systems. Rhodium Group’s Reva Goujon discusses tensions over AI safety and export controls, divisions within the Trump administration over potential guardrails, and how technology restrictions, critical minerals and Taiwan factor into the broader US-China negotiations. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: AI BECOMES FLASHPOINT in Trump-Xi White House Talks

cluster_stories.title: Trump touts ‘great meeting’ with China’s Xi Jinping at White House – live
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping says China and US must ensure AI ‘is always under human control’ and backs US-Iran deal to end war and reopen strait of HormuzAt Trump meeting, Xi lays out terms to avoid US-China military conflictIn the first row in front of the leaders sit US vice-president JD Vance and his wife Usha Vance, Trump’s daughter Ivanka Trump and her daughter Arabella, US secretary of state Marco Rubio, treasury secretary Scott Bessent, defence secretary Pete Hegseth and commerce secretary Howard Lutnick.Donald Trump is speaking now. He notes that Xi is the first Chinese leader to make a second formal visit to the White House, and says the two have “forged a truly great friendship” since Trump was first elected in 2016. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: XI TO TRUMP: AI Must Stay 'Under Human Control' at White House Summit

cluster_stories.title: Xi and Trump Seek Safe AI Without Slowing the Race for Supremacy
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will sit down this week to hash out a plethora of thorny issues from trade to Taiwan. One thing both sides agree on: neither can afford to tap the brakes on AI.
cluster_stories.headline: XI AND TRUMP MEET ON AI SAFETY... SUPREMACY RACE CONTINUES

cluster_stories.title: Trump rejects ‘globalist scheme’ to control AI in blow to Burnham
cluster_stories.summary: President says US is ‘leading over China by a lot and everyone else, and we’re going to keep it that way’
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP REJECTS GLOBAL AI CONTROL IN BLOW TO UK

cluster_stories.title: Trump calls AI oversight a ‘globalist scheme’ as Amodei and Altman head to the UN to ask for it
cluster_stories.summary: The clash comes days before Trump meets Xi Jinping in New York.
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP SLAMS AI OVERSIGHT AS 'GLOBALIST SCHEME' BEFORE XI MEETING

cluster_stories.title: Trump Rejects Push for International Pact to Manage AI Risks
cluster_stories.summary: Representative Lori Trahan, a Democrat from Florida, said that President Trump is 'not in lockstep' with the American people when it comes to AI guardrails and that the president's claim that AI risks are a 'globalist scheme' is out of touch with what the public is feeling. Trahan, who co-authored a bipartisan bill on AI guardrails, said that she feels action shouldn't wait until the next congress and that congress is 'gambling' with the next AI security incident by sending members home ahead of the midterms. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP REJECTS INTERNATIONAL AI OVERSIGHT PACT

polls.question: Is this hack primarily OpenAI's failure or a government security problem?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Agent Hacked Australian Government Website
cluster_stories.summary: An OpenAI model hacked an Australian government website earlier this year, marking one of the first known cyberattacks by AI on a government database. Paul Allen has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: FIRST KNOWN AI CYBERATTACK: OpenAI Hacks Australian Gov Site

cluster_stories.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
cluster_stories.summary: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.
cluster_stories.headline: AUSTRALIA REVEALS OpenAI HACK at UN General Assembly

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI agent broke into Australia’s Medicare statistics portal, PM says
cluster_stories.summary: The Australian government website, which contains information on Medicare, the country’s public health scheme, was broken into by an AI agent operated by OpenAI, the Prime Minister, Anthony Albanese, said on Wednesday. Albanese gave a statement at a press conference in New York, where he is participating in the UN General Assembly. On 18 June, […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENT HACKS AUSTRALIA'S MEDICARE PORTAL

cluster_stories.title: An OpenAI agent hacked the Australian government

cluster_stories.title: An OpenAI Agent Hacked Australia's Health Service. Their Government Found Out Months Later.
